hypotheses.justification: The statement only uses Nat.card, which needs no Finiteness. If V is infinite then Nat.card V = 0, so hcop (Nat.Coprime (Nat.card A) 0) forces Nat.card A = 1. Then A is trivial, so ρ.range is trivial and FixedPoints.subgroup ρ.range V is all of V. Then for any x : V ⧸ N, any lift v works, so the conclusion holds. If V is finite, the existing proof goes through unchanged. A `by_cases Finite V` handles both cases. This is independent of deleting [Finite A]; each can be dropped on its own.
